Contract Generator.contract:
Contract ProcessSaleService::enterItem(barcode: Integer,quantity: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		barcode: Integer,
		quantity: Integer
	precondition:
		CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and
		Item.allInstance()->exists(i|i.Barcode = barcode and
		i.StockNumber>=quantity)
	postcondition:
		let item: Item = Item.allInstance()->any(i|i.Barcode = barcode) in
		let line: SalesLineItem in
		line.oclIsNew() and
		CurrentSale.ContainedSalesLine->includes(line) and
		line.BelongedSale = CurrentSale and
		line.Item = item and
		line.Quantity = quantity and
		line.Subamount = item.Price*quantity and
		item.StockNumber = item.StockNumber-quantity and
		result = true
}
